title: Cloudflare
description: Cloudflare analytics queried live from its GraphQL API; history is limited to what Cloudflare keeps (31 days, 184 for Web Analytics).

url_options.body_graphql_query: query { viewer { zones(filter: { zoneTag: "$zone" }) { x: httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 1, filter: { datetime_geq: "${__from:date:iso}", datetime_lt: "${__to:date:iso}" }) { count sum { edgeResponseBytes visits } } } } }

query { viewer { zones(filter: { zoneTag: "$zone" }) { x: httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: { datetime_geq: "${__from:date:iso}", datetime_lt: "${__to:date:iso}" }, orderBy: [datetimeHour_ASC]) { count dimensions { datetimeHour cacheStatus } } } } }

query { viewer { zones(filter: { zoneTag: "$zone" }) { x: httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: { datetime_geq: "${__from:date:iso}", datetime_lt: "${__to:date:iso}" }, orderBy: [datetimeHour_ASC]) { sum { edgeResponseBytes } dimensions { datetimeHour cacheStatus } } } } }
